title: CNBC Squawk Box — Eric on AI productivity and the Anthropic governance work he started years before AI governance went mainstream
summary: Eric returned to CNBC's Squawk Box to discuss the state of the AI race and Anthropic's call for AI labs to slow development collectively. He said it is very early to see AI's effects on productivity.
blockquote:
Years before AI governance became a mainstream concern, Long-Term Stock Exchange Founder Eric Ries advised Anthropic on its long-term governance structure.

Eric joined CNBC Squawk Box today to discuss why governance matters as much as technology in shaping AI's long-term impact.
attribution_title: The national securities exchange built for long-term mission alignment, on Eric's return to CNBC Squawk Box
